q.en: Can both parents also be surprised at the gender reveal?

a.en: Absolutely. Your sonographer or trusted friend can hand the sealed envelope or digital result directly to your dedicated Managevent coordinator, who prepares the reveal cake or installation in complete confidence.

q.en: Are confetti cannons allowed in Perth public parks?

a.en: Most Perth local councils strictly prohibit plastic confetti and powder cannons on public reserves. We design council-compliant reveals for public parks—such as bespoke reveal cakes, balloon boxes, and floral installations—so your bond is protected.

q.en: Can we combine a Baby Shower and Gender Reveal into one Perth event?

a.en: Yes. Many Perth families combine their baby shower high tea with a signature reveal moment, using our digital invitation suite to manage RSVPs, dietary needs, and registry notes.
